has invited you to see Example University & "Partners" 100%'s students in the WordPress Credits Program on WordPress Credits.

https://example.test/wp-admin/admin-post.php?action=wpcpm_accept_invite&t=EXAMPLE-NOT-A-REAL-TOKEN-0721

sponsor-applied-name-as-cleaned.subject: [WordPress Credits] We have your application: SAPP-2036-0801
sponsor-applied-name-as-cleaned.body:
Thank you for offering to sponsor the WordPress Credits Program on behalf of Acme <3 "Co" & Sons. Your application is with us.

Your reference is SAPP-2036-0801. Please quote it if you write to us about this application.

What happens next: an Administrator reads every application by hand and checks the company and its products against the program's licensing and trademark rules, so a reply takes a few working days. If the program says yes, we will set up an account on the program site and send you a link to choose a password.

This message went to sol at example.test because that address was given on the sponsor application form at WordPress Credits. If it was not you, you can ignore it: nothing happens until an Administrator decides.

-- 
WordPress Credits, WordPress Education
This email comes from the WordPress Credits program.
